faq.q: Do I need my own agent to attend a Ladner open house?
faq.a: BCFSA states a licensee must work for either the buyer or the seller, must inform consumers of the duties owed to clients and non-clients, and must inform unrepresented consumers of the risks of dealing with a professional who represents another party.

faq.q: Does every listing on the Ladner open-houses page hold an open house?
faq.a: Not necessarily: of six listings checked, five showed an open house time and one (a farm listing in rural Ladner) showed none. If a listing doesn't show an open house time, ask before you go.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Ladner Open is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
